name: Amara Nwosu
quote: I spent two years trying to break into commercial work with no luck. Next Stage had me booked within weeks. The team matched me to exactly the right briefs and supported me through every step. Genuinely life-changing.

name: Tom Ellsworth
quote: I expected the usual agency delays but instead got a call within 48 hours and three campaign shortlistings in month one. Fast, honest and completely professional. The best agency decision I have made.

name: Yuki Tanaka
quote: Breaking into London from Tokyo felt impossible until I found Next Stage. They understood my look immediately, placed me well and communicated brilliantly throughout. A truly international-minded team.

name: Declan Byrne
quote: Next Stage helped me move from voice work into presenting. They built my profile strategically and within four months I had my first on-screen credit. Exceptional support from start to finish.

name: Fatima Al-Rashid
quote: I came to modelling at 48 after my children were grown. Next Stage never treated my age as a barrier. TV drama, two print campaigns and a team I completely trust. Wish I had done this years ago.

name: Lena Hartmann
quote: I had almost given up on agencies after being messed around for two years. Next Stage Talent was completely different from the start. Clear communication, no hidden costs, and they actually put me forward for work that matched my look. Three bookings in my first three months.

name: Ryan Okafor
quote: The team took the time to properly understand what kind of work I was looking for. I didn't feel like just another name on a list. They submitted me for the right roles, and I've since had credits on two UK drama series. Really grateful.

name: Isabella Reyes
quote: I joined straight out of modelling school and had zero professional credits. Next Stage Talent not only signed me but gave me practical advice on building my book. I now have eight editorial credits and my first international campaign.

name: George Papadopoulos
quote: I'm 58 and came to Next Stage Talent thinking they might not have much for someone my age. I was completely wrong. They placed me in a supermarket campaign, a financial services ad, and a short film within six months. Age is not a barrier here.

name: Natasha Bloom
quote: What I appreciated most was that they were upfront about timelines. They told me bookings don't happen overnight, to keep my expectations realistic, and that they'd submit me consistently. Every word was true. I've been steady with work for eight months now.

name: Callum Donnelly
role: TV Extra and Background Artist, Glasgow
quote: I was sceptical about signing with any agency after reading horror stories online. But Next Stage Talent charge no joining fee, explained everything clearly, and within three weeks I was on set for a BBC production. Exactly what they promised.

name: Mei Lin Chow
quote: The agency matched me with brands that genuinely suited my look rather than just submitting me for everything and hoping for the best. That targeted approach made all the difference. I've had three beauty brand campaigns and a wellness shoot so far.

name: Jordan Baptiste
quote: I have no formal training — I was spotted through an open call. Next Stage Talent saw something in me, guided me through the whole process, and got me booked for a high street clothing campaign. Could not have done it without them.

name: Siobhan Murray
quote: As someone from outside the UK, I wasn't sure an English agency would take me seriously. Not only did they sign me, they actively promoted me for London-based dance campaign work. The whole team is warm, professional, and responsive.

name: Andre Williams
role: Brand Ambassador and Promotional Model, London
quote: I've worked with two other agencies and the difference with Next Stage Talent is stark. They actually reply to your emails, update you on submissions, and explain why you did or didn't get a role. That transparency is everything.

name: Poppy Sutherland
role: Child and Family Model, aged 7, Sheffield
quote: My mum was worried about signing me up with an agency. But Next Stage Talent made the whole process so relaxed and family-friendly. We always knew what was happening, and I've done three family campaign shoots so far. It's been brilliant!

name: Victor Mensah
quote: I came in with a very specific look — athletic, afro-caribbean, mid-thirties — and wasn't sure how many opportunities would come up. Next Stage Talent placed me in two sportswear campaigns and a TV health ad within four months. Very impressed.

name: Harriet Cole
quote: My look is niche — I have a very vintage, old-Hollywood feel — and previous agencies just didn't know what to do with me. Next Stage Talent immediately saw who I was and started pitching me to the right clients. First booking came in week two.

name: Tariq Hassan
quote: I joined primarily for acting work but the team encouraged me to explore voice work too. Best advice I ever took. I've since narrated two corporate campaigns and a children's audiobook series through bookings they arranged.

name: Emma Cartwright
quote: The fashion industry has been slow to embrace diversity but the brands Next Stage Talent work with are exactly the kind doing it right. I've had six plus-size fashion shoots and two high street lookbook credits. Representation matters and they get it.

name: Liam Farrell
quote: I do a lot of physical work — stunts, sports doubles, action sequences. Not every agency understands that market. Next Stage Talent have specialist contacts in production and got me three stunt extra credits on back-to-back productions.

name: Nadia Kowalski
quote: English is my second language and I was nervous about working with a UK agency. The team were patient, explained everything twice when needed, and never made me feel like an outsider. I now have four campaign credits and feel completely at home.

name: Bertie Hammond
quote: I retired at 65 and signed up on a whim after my grandchildren dared me. I expected nothing. I've now done a retirement planning ad, a gardening brand shoot, and a short film. Next Stage Talent found my niche and ran with it.

name: Priscilla Adeyemi
quote: I've done a lot of event work and was looking for an agency that understood that sector. Next Stage Talent connected me with brand activation clients I never would have found myself. Regular, well-paid work with great brands.

name: Sam Whitfield
quote: I identify as non-binary and wasn't sure how progressive agencies in the UK had become. Next Stage Talent were completely inclusive from day one — no assumptions, no awkward questions, just professional representation. They've booked me for three progressive brand campaigns already.
